payload.core_mechanism_summary: 2D DP over counts of columns with remaining need 1 and 2, adding rows with two ones.
payload.rationale: The solution maintains a 2D table mat[i][j] where i and j are numbers of columns needing 1 and 2 more ones, respectively. It iterates over possible numbers of rows/columns and uses combinatorial transition formulas. This matches dp_2d_state with a counting flavor.
